description:
Misión: Crear soluciones tecnológicas innovadoras, desarrollar proyectos inteligentes y convertir grandes ideas en realidades.
Visión: Convertirse en un referente de innovación, investigación y desarrollo tecnológico, llevando las ideas más allá de los límites conocidos.
Filosofía: No existen límites para quienes se atreven a imaginar, investigar, construir e innovar.
ORBITAL GUARDIAN: el futuro no se espera, se construye.
summary: Orbital Guardian is a real-time 3D geospatial command center that integrates over 13,000 active thermal anomalies from NASA FIRMS with live meteorological forecasts and atmospheric physics (Magnus-Tetens Vapor Pressure Deficit and Fosberg Fire Weather Index) to predict 6-to-12-hour wildfire spread and generate actionable evacuation protocols.
details:
Unlike passive map viewers that merely display historical fire dots, Orbital Guardian transforms NASA open Earth observation data into life-saving tactical intelligence. Its scientific engine cross-references NASA FIRMS 24-hour global datasets (MODIS/VIIRS) using Haversine geodesic distance calculations with real-time hourly weather forecasts, rendering 3D wind-driven fire and smoke propagation vectors on an interactive globe. The platform features five integrated modules: 3D Exploration with Orbital Patrol, a Physical Simulation Lab, a Crisis Room with printable emergency reports, a Transparent Mathematical Log, and an AI Tactical Assistant.Judges' Quick Guide & Notes:

1. Individual Entry: Designed, coded, and edited entirely by a solo participant.

2. Language: The live interface is in Spanish for emergency responders in Latin America; right-clicking in Chrome ("Translate to English") or viewing the universal scientific metrics (VPD, FRP, FFWI) allows seamless evaluation.

3. How to Test: Click any orange thermal hotspot on the 3D globe (or search any city) to view real-time weather, 6h/12h wind propagation vectors, and the interactive Fosberg Risk Simulator under the "Análisis" tab.
